source.label: Google Business Profile · authorized Chrome account
caveats: Profile status and closure labels remain the dated Business Profile registry.
Ratings and review counts come from public Google Maps listings and use per-branch reviewFetchedAt. Failed or ambiguous matches retain previous values.
Public Maps responses can be throttled or change shape; refresh status reports every failure.

metricDefinitions.label: Verified
metricDefinitions.definition: Rows whose supplied status is exactly Verified. Verified / all rows gives the verification rate.

metricDefinitions.label: Attention
metricDefinitions.definition: Unique rows with status other than Verified, an explicit closure, or a repeated store code. Conditions may overlap.

evidenceFlow.title: Source
evidenceFlow.detail: User pasted 66 business records from Google Business Profile group 104765881644272532999.

evidenceFlow.title: Import
evidenceFlow.detail: Read each store code and name, preserve the address, separate closure labels from verification status. Keep store codes as strings including leading zeros.

evidenceFlow.title: Availability
evidenceFlow.detail: No ratings or reviews were supplied; null remains unavailable, never zero.

evidenceFlow.title: Authorized browser verification
evidenceFlow.detail: Read all 66 rows and profile-link identifiers in the signed-in stc Kuwait group. The group header reports 58 verified. Row labels agree with the supplied list.

evidenceFlow.title: Arabic source check
evidenceFlow.detail: Arabic group page also displays all 66 profiles with the same English names and addresses; status labels read from the Arabic page: مُثبَت الملكية, يجب تأكيد البيانات, تكرار, تم النشر.

evidenceFlow.title: Public Maps refresh
evidenceFlow.detail: Searched public Google Maps listings by branch name in Kuwait; 40 branches succeeded and 26 failed. Exact or high-confidence name matching only.

methods.code: Parse tab-separated store code and business name; collect address until status; separate explicit closure. Count repeated exact store codes without merging locations.
